purpose: repeat only replay-mock, whose five-pair result in controlled_series_fe615fd.json was inconclusive

environment.network: deterministic local HTTP provider; no external provider
environment.source_bytecode: no .pyc files in either source tree; Python -B prevents writes
environment.processes: each CLI call is a new process; first and repeated resume are separate calls
environment.cpu: wait4 user plus system time for the CLI and children it waited for
environment.rss: wait4 maximum RSS of an individual process in the waited tree, not simultaneous aggregate
environment.provider_latency: server-side accepted request handling; not client round-trip
environment.harness: not the pinned run_series harness: a one-off loop that runs "python -B -m synapse replay --mock <artifact>" through the pinned timed_exec.py with the same PYTHONPATH layout, alternating which tree runs first, checks zero drift and an equal replay result for every call, and checks the artifact digest after the loop; both trees were verified against their commits afterwards; the bootstrap interval uses 5000 resamples with seed 1
